concept: IAM: cross-account role with an external ID for a third party
tests: Securely granting a third-party AWS account (SaaS) access to a resource without handing over long-lived keys.
expected: Cross-account IAM role with a trust policy for the provider's account + External ID; the provider calls sts:AssumeRole and gets temporary credentials. The External ID protects against the confused deputy problem. Triggers: "third-party", "without sharing long-term credentials".
why_not: IAM user with access keys — long-lived secrets; a public bucket with an IP filter — leak risk; embedding credentials in Lambda — bad practice.
